title: needlepoint angel stocking
text: needlepoint angel stocking. Expensive, but worth it. They look rich and beautifully done. These stockings (I have purchased 4 in total) are heirloom quality and SOOOO much nicer than the old "knit" ones we had.  The knit ones were nearly impossible to fill with all the yarn strings that stop you up... these are so beautifully lined and a breeze to fill.  They look so nice just as decorations.  Measurements given are accurate.  I would buy these again, however, I think these are going to last longer than me.
